title: Tabulation machine step
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean symbols, and let $y$ be a finite Boolean input word. For any state $q$ of the tabulation machine, valid input-head position $p$, contents and head positions for the work tapes of $M$, contents and head positions for three auxiliary tapes, and Boolean output word, one step of the tabulation machine from the resulting configuration is the configuration obtained by applying the action prescribed by its transition function to that configuration. The transition function is evaluated at the symbol scanned on the input tape and the symbols scanned on the original and auxiliary work tapes.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$p$ is a valid input-head position for $y$
